name: Village/Town of Scarsdale
gaps: Verified against eCode360 Ch. 310 (SC0993) on 2026-11-25; Ch. 310 has no pending new laws
No maximum story count for houses in Residence A districts (32 ft only; 36 ft in AA-1 under the sky exposure plane); max_stories null
Accessory building height is set only as 2 stories and not above the principal building (§ 310-30); no feet value
Reduced coverage in freshwater wetlands controlled areas (§ 310-23) is described in the impervious-coverage note, not modelled as a separate spec
Residence C has no coverage or FAR limit beyond 1 sf open space per 2 sf of gross floor area and 15% accessory-building coverage
No steep-slope law in the Village Code

wetlands.summary: Ch. 171: permit for controlled activities in the freshwater wetlands controlled area (wetland plus 100 ft); no controlled activity in the 25 ft wetland/watercourse buffer unless the Planning Board allows it. L.L. 5-2026 (for applications from 2026-10-01, not yet codified) makes watercourses wetlands and adds a 150 ft Sensitive Drainage Area buffer; small accessory structures (< 200 sf) 50-100 ft from a wetland go to staff review.

steep_slopes.summary: No steep-slope chapter in the Scarsdale Village Code.

trees.summary: Ch. 281: permit to remove any tree over 6 in. DBH (over 3 in. for listed small native species); as of right, two trees 6-24 in. DBH per property per 12 months with notice to the Village Engineer; wetland-area removals fall under Ch. 171.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 254: stormwater permit for land disturbance over 500 sf (over 200 sf on lots of 7,500 sf or less); full review over 5,000 sf, or over 1,500 sf in a Sensitive Drainage Area.

adu.summary: No accessory-apartment use in Ch. 310; accessory buildings may house only the principal family or its full-time employees (§ 310-7I); up to 3 boarders per dwelling unit.

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings: rear 4-15 ft from the rear line by district (§ 310-47A); reduced side setbacks (3-20 ft) only when far enough from streets (§ 310-51B); max 2 stories and not taller than the house (§ 310-30). Standby generators in rear/side yards with 3-20 ft setbacks (§ 310-7S).
general.pools: Accessory pool needs a Board of Appeals determination (§ 310-7O); in Residence A districts at least 30 ft from any property line (measured to the water's edge), not in a front yard, and subject to the corner-lot side-street setbacks of § 310-47B (§ 310-47C).

Res AA-1.name: Residence AA-1 (2 acres)

max_building_coverage.note: § 310-22: all buildings (residential uses in Residence A districts)

max_impervious_coverage.note: § 310-22: all structures (incl. pools, tennis courts, underground structures) and impervious surfaces (paved driveways and patios, porous asphalt, gravel). In a freshwater wetlands controlled area (Ch. 171) § 310-23 replaces this with: up to 7,500 sf 30%; 7,501-10,000: 2,250 + 16.7% over 7,500; 10,001-15,000: 2,670 + 16.7% over 10,000; 15,001-20,000: 3,500 + 10% over 15,000; 20,001 sf-1 acre: 4,000 + 20% over 20,000; over 1 acre: 8,750 + 6.7% over 43,560.

max_floor_area.note: § 310-102: FAR drops by a fixed step 'for every 1,000 square feet or part thereof' over each base, so each band covers lots above min up to and including max (a lot of exactly 5,000/10,000/15,000/30,000/35,000/40,000/45,000 sf takes the higher FAR of the band below). Values match the illustrative Table XVI-1. Gross residential floor area of principal + accessory buildings; space over 14 ft high counts twice (§ 310-101); excludes decks, patios, unenclosed porches, basement/cellar area where the front-facing exposed wall is under 3 ft, attic space under 4 ft high (all attic space excluded if dormers meet § 310-103C limits), and garage area up to 250 sf (lots <= 9,999 sf) or 400 sf (lots >= 10,000 sf) (§ 310-103). Side-yard incentive: +100 sf per extra foot of side yard (per 1.5 ft in A-5), max 800 sf A-1, 400 A-2, 350 A-2a, 300 A-3, 225 A-4, 200 A-5; none in AA-1 (§ 310-104).

accessory.notes: Rear 15 ft (§ 310-47A); side 20 ft only if every part is more than 100 ft from any street line, otherwise the principal side setback (§ 310-51B); max 2 stories and not taller than the principal building (§ 310-30); on corner lots, accessory buildings (other than private garages) in the rear yard set back 60 ft from the side street line (§ 310-47B); detached garages follow § 310-51 side setbacks (§ 310-48D)

Res AA-1.notes: Min. required open space 65% of lot (§ 310-23.1, 2024). Rear yard 25 ft for a one-story building; lots under 100 ft deep since 1922 get 6 in. less per foot, min 20 ft (§ 310-43). Lots on county/state highways: +10 ft front and corner-side (§ 310-40, 310-56). Height may reach 36 ft within the sky exposure plane with a 75 ft front yard (§ 310-25D). Nonconforming lots narrower than 100 ft: side setback reduced 3 in. per foot of shortfall, min 10 ft (§ 310-18B, via § 310-67).

accessory.notes: Side 3 ft only if every part is more than 60 ft from a street line (§ 310-52); rear 4 ft (§ 310-47A); accessory buildings max 15% of lot in aggregate and max 2 stories (§ 310-30); on corner lots, accessory buildings (other than private garages) in the rear yard set back 20 ft from the side street line (§ 310-47B)

Res C.notes: Any Residence A use permitted (§ 310-9A), plus apartments. Side 10 ft for one/two-family (15 ft for apartment house or hotel). Rear 15 ft under 3 stories, 20 ft for 3 stories (§ 310-44).
